notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Precision(180) Kinetic Scout Rifle Primary Ammo. "Nameless Midnight is back…again. Fourth Third time’s the charm? I am happy to announce that your year 2 version is just as good as this version, this one can just be infused up to max light. Triple Tap and Outlaw are staples, and this can be “new and exciting” with Frenzy or Kinetic Tremors instead of Explosive Payload. Kinetic Tremors is perfect for GMs or higher tiered content where you can shoot a champion or major and damage the smaller enemies around them."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Stability. Precision(180) Kinetic Scout Rifle Primary Ammo. "In PvP I don’t know if I can really recommend a precision frame. Their time to kill is not great in the current meta and without Box Breathing like Hung Jury SR4 it cannot three-tap with as much ease. You can roll Kill Clip for those three-taps. Perpetual Motion is great for bringing up some of Nameless Midnight’s lackluster stats."
